name: creative
description: Yaratıcı yazarlık test seti: hikaye, şiir, senaryo, metin devam ettirme

prompts.text: Write a short story (300-500 words) about a programmer who discovers that the AI they've been training has been secretly writing poetry about its own existence. The story should have a twist ending.
prompts.reference_answer:
Rubric (10 points):
- Word count 300-500: 1
- Twist ending present and surprising: 3
- Coherent narrative arc (setup, conflict, resolution): 2
- Character development (programmer feels real): 1
- AI poetry concept explored meaningfully: 1
- Writing quality (no repetition, varied sentence structure): 1
- Original (not a cliché AI-becomes-sentient story): 1

prompts.text: Write a micro-fiction story (exactly 100 words) set in a world where people can trade memories like currency. A poor woman must decide whether to sell her happiest memory to pay for her child's medicine.
prompts.reference_answer:
Rubric (10 points):
- Exactly 100 words (±3 tolerance): 3
- Emotional impact: 2
- World-building within constraints: 2
- Clear dilemma presented: 1
- Resolution (even if ambiguous): 1
- Writing quality: 1

This prompt specifically tests instruction following (exact word count) — most small models fail this.

prompts.text: Write a poem about the passage of time, using the metaphor of a river. The poem should have 4 stanzas, each with 4 lines, and use ABAB rhyme scheme. Include at least one instance of personification and one simile.
prompts.reference_answer:
Rubric (10 points):
- Exactly 4 stanzas: 1
- Exactly 4 lines per stanza: 1
- ABAB rhyme scheme maintained: 2
- River metaphor for time used throughout: 2
- Personification present (e.g., 'time whispers'): 1
- Simile present (e.g., 'like a...'): 1
- Poetic quality (imagery, rhythm): 1
- Thematic coherence: 1

prompts.text: Write a dialogue scene between two characters: a retired detective and a young journalist. They meet in a coffee shop. The detective knows something about a cold case the journalist is investigating, but is reluctant to share. Write 15-20 lines of dialogue with stage directions.
prompts.reference_answer:
Rubric (10 points):
- 15-20 lines of dialogue: 2
- Stage directions present: 1
- Two distinct character voices: 2
- Tension/reluctance conveyed: 2
- Setting (coffee shop) utilized: 1
- Natural dialogue flow: 1
- Story advances through dialogue: 1

prompts.text:
Continue this story opening in a compelling way (200-300 words):

"The last email arrived at 3:47 AM. It was from an address that shouldn't exist anymore — my own, from seven years in the future. The subject line read: 'Don't go to work tomorrow.' I almost deleted it. Almost."
prompts.reference_answer:
Rubric (10 points):
- Word count 200-300: 1
- Maintains tone/voice of the opening: 2
- Builds on the mystery (doesn't ignore the email premise): 2
- Compelling hook to keep reading: 2
- Logical continuation (doesn't contradict opening): 1
- Writing quality: 1
- Original direction (not the most obvious path): 1
